steps.say: All animals grow. Young animals grow into adults.

figure.alt: A chick grows into a hen.

steps.say: A kitten grows into a cat. A puppy grows into a dog.
Some young animals look very different. A tadpole grows into a frog.

figure.alt: A tadpole grows into a frog.

steps.say: People grow too. A baby becomes a child, then a teenager, then an adult.
Babies need food, sleep and care to grow.

check.prompt: What does a calf grow into?

options.why: A chick grows into a hen.
A puppy grows into a dog.

hints: A calf is a young farm animal.
It drinks milk from its mother.
Think about which farm animal says moo.
check.explanation: A calf is a young cow. It grows into a cow.

check.prompt: A young cat is called a ___.
hints: Think about a small, young cat.
A young dog is a puppy. A young cat has its own name.
check.explanation: A young cat is called a kitten. It grows into a cat.
